title: Not the best calendar
body: Why wont the icon show the real date? I sometimes need to just check what date is today and in stead of just checking the app icon on my phone I have to actually open the app. Also, why is the reminder set automatically for 10 min before an event? Im not the flash. I sometimes set an appointment in a rush and then forget about it completely and then I have 10min to get to the other side of the city. And one last thing. Can you please please change the name to just calendar or something. google calendar is too long and if its next to google maps it gets weird. All the other apps have just one name. Why google has to be the maria ana garcia lopez eduardo of apps?

body:
For many months now the app occassionally does not alert for appointments on iPhone 7 Plus, which were surely setup properly.
